sanskrit_verse:
पृथगायव्ययधनाः कुसीदं च परस्परम् ।
वणिक्पथं च ये कुर्युर् विभक्तास् ते न संशयः ॥
transliteration: pṛthagāyavyayadhanāḥ kusīdaṃ ca parasparam / vaṇikpathaṃ ca ye kuryur vibhaktās te na saṃśayaḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who maintain separate accounts for income, expenditure, and capital, who mutually sustain surplus funds, and engage in trade routes — such individuals are undeniably distinct entities under Dharma.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority rests on clear demarcation of economic roles and responsibilities
Causation arises from intentional engagement in structured commercial activity
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by operational independence and financial clarity
Restoration logic requires preservation of individual economic sovereignty
Consciousness alignment manifests through honest separation of fiscal domains
executable_legal_axioms: IF an entity maintains independent records of income, expense, and capital THEN it shall be recognized as a distinct legal unit
IF parties sustain mutual surpluses without coercive integration THEN their contractual unity remains unassailable
IF a trader operates along established trade paths with documented autonomy THEN no external authority may dissolve that operational integrity
IF financial boundaries are preserved without deception THEN no liability merger shall occur post-facto
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving corporate personhood or partnership dissolution, the threshold of responsibility lies in whether clear, separate accounting was maintained. The Supreme Court must affirm that autonomous economic actors cannot be retroactively merged into collective liability when their transactions were transparent and mutually sustaining.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: By pramāṇa, factual maintenance of discrete ledgers demonstrates vyavahāra-samarthyam (transactional capacity). As per anupūrvaśaḥ, sequential acts of maintaining distinct wealth flows affirm ontological separation. Thus, responsibility aligns proportionally with demonstrated fiscal independence. There is no punitive element; only recognition of what has always existed: svatantryam (self-sovereignty).
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Entities must finalize all pending reconciliations where record distinctions were blurred
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Each party confirms ownership of respective assets and liabilities via sworn declaration
Capacity Restoration: Re-establishment of accurate bookkeeping systems where prior confusion occurred
Integrity Reintegration: Public acknowledgment of corrected status before relevant commercial registry
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: Economic distinction is affirmed, Dharma is restored, reality remains non-punitive, and consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
